title: Orbital Age
purpose: Make Earth orbit the first mandatory destination and establish a survivable, expandable station.
optimization_opportunities: Pre-manufacture station systems, pack launches carefully, and reuse orbital power and docking infrastructure.
infrastructure_reuse: Nuclear manufacturing builds launch hardware; the orbital station remains a research, power, cargo, and shipyard hub.

milestones.title: Tier 1 Orbital Launch
final_validation: Build a Tier 1 launch system and safely reach Earth orbit; this alone does not authorize Moon access.

milestones.title: Pressurized Orbital Habitat
final_validation: Establish pressure, oxygen, storage, and safe habitation in orbit.

milestones.title: Orbital Power and Eclipse Storage
final_validation: Install IC2 solar generation and enough stored power to survive an eclipse.

milestones.title: Orbital Communications and Telemetry
final_validation: Bring a ComputerCraft telemetry and communications system online.

milestones.title: Research Station
milestones.temporary_validation: Obtain the test Research Station item. Final validation requires the modular powered station platform.

milestones.title: Orbital Experiment Module
final_validation: Demonstrate the capability: Orbital Experiment Module.
milestones.temporary_validation: Obtain the test experiment module. Final validation requires a real environment-aware module.

milestones.title: Functional Orbital Station
final_validation: Sustain habitation, oxygen, power, storage, telemetry, research equipment, and safe arrival infrastructure.
milestones.temporary_validation: Manual-check the assembled station until environment/uptime triggers exist.
